citation.title: Effects of density gradients and fluctuations at the plasma edge on ECEI measurements at ASDEX Upgrade
citation.authors: B Vanovac, E Wolfrum, S S Denk, F Mink, F M Laggner, G Birkenmeier, M Willensdorfer, E Viezzer, M Hoelzl, S J Freethy, M G Dunne, A Lessig, N C Luhmann Jr, ASDEX Upgrade Team, EUROfusion MST1 Team
citation.doi_or_arxiv: 10.1088/1361-6587/aaa7ac (this paper's own DOI, PDF p2 header; distinct from DOIs of cited works)

scope_read.pdf_pages: 1-12 (p1 publisher cover; journal pp1-11 = PDF pp2-12)
scope_read.limitations: Figure values are read from rendered images only. Forward-model internals are deferred to ref [11].

claim_checks.proposed_claim: Edge ECEI channels can be dominated by shine-through rather than local emission.
claim_checks.source_finding: Forward modelling (ECFM) of AUG #33616 profiles shows that, in steady state, channels with cold resonances in the SOL receive relativistically down-shifted emission from inside the separatrix. In a JOREK-based ELM-filament case, about 300 eV of shine-through appears in the SOL.
claim_checks.locator: PDF p5, Sec 3, Figs 3-4; PDF p6, Fig 5; summary PDF p10, Sec 8
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: Radiation-transport modelling of oblique ECEI at ASDEX Upgrade indicates that, at the plasma edge, the observed emission may originate away from the cold resonance, including shine-through from the pedestal [Vanovac2018].
claim_checks.qualification: This is a modelling result for one AUG geometry: single ray, O-mode neglected, IF bandwidth included. It is not a measurement. The authors also conclude that, for typical H-mode profiles, Trad ≈ Te inside the separatrix (PDF p6, Sec 4).

claim_checks.proposed_claim: Density fluctuations contribute to the edge ECEI radiation temperature.
claim_checks.source_finding: An 8 kHz inter-ELM mode is seen on ECEI, 1D ECE and Li-BES. The Li-BES forward model gives δn/n of roughly 20-40%. In ECFM, a 20% density perturbation near ρpol≈0.983 produces about a 3% Trad change, and the responses cannot be distinguished across input δTe/Te of 0, 0.1 and 0.15. The authors state that modelled and measured amplitudes cannot be directly compared.
claim_checks.locator: PDF p8, Sec 5, Fig 9; PDF p9, Sec 6, Fig 10
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: In the steep-gradient region, modelled density perturbations alter the ECE radiation temperature, so edge ECEI fluctuations need not reflect electron-temperature fluctuations alone [Vanovac2018].
claim_checks.qualification: Evidence comes from one discharge plus forward modelling. The causal attribution is the authors' interpretation, and the ~3% value should not be transferred to another device.

claim_checks.proposed_claim: The authors state the conclusions generally rather than as device-specific.
claim_checks.source_finding: The closing statement is phrased generally: the ECEI signal can be dominated by density-profile changes and need not reflect Te fluctuation amplitude. The supporting evidence, however, is AUG-specific (oblique view angles, #33616/#33195).
claim_checks.locator: PDF p2, abstract; PDF p11, Sec 8
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: Studies at ASDEX Upgrade caution that edge ECEI signals can carry density as well as temperature information [Vanovac2018]; accordingly, we treat BES/ECEI snapshots as uncalibrated features rather than Te/ne measurements.
claim_checks.qualification: The paper analyses calibrated Trad, not raw voltages, and studies no KSTAR data. Our voltage-feature choice is our own design decision, not something this paper prescribes.

input_target_timing.causal_or_offline: not_applicable; the analysis is offline diagnostic interpretation
input_target_timing.reported_vs_physical_truth: Trad is modelled from assumed Te/ne profiles; no independent truth is claimed.

validation.unknowns: Uncertainty on the Li-BES δn/n estimate and on ECFM outputs is not quantified.

runtime_or_deployment.what_not_established: any real-time use or computation time

forbidden_inferences: That the paper addresses CES, ion or carbon temperature
Transfer of the 3% or 20-40% figures to KSTAR
That raw ECEI voltages were studied or shown uncalibratable
That edge ECEI never measures Te (the authors find Trad≈Te inside the separatrix for typical profiles)
Any identified physical mechanism of the 8 kHz mode (the authors offer three unresolved hypotheses, PDF pp10-11)
competing_or_complementary: Complementary. It motivates cautious, feature-level use of edge ECEI and the inclusion of density-sensitive BES. It does not compete as an estimator.
